# Clashware

> Clashware Sàrl is a Swiss technology company based in Lausanne, Switzerland (founded 2025, UID CHE-178.795.076). It builds enterprise-grade software, AI systems, and digital products with a focus on software engineering, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Founded by three EPFL engineers: Kamyar Taher (Co-founder & CEO), Bastien Faivre (Co-founder & Systems Engineer), and Nils Delage (Co-founder & Full-Stack Developer).

Tagline: Swiss Precision. Bold Innovation.

## Products

- [Metacube](https://metacube.games): Massive multiplayer treasure hunting game. Compete with thousands, discover hidden prizes.
- [Bonega.ai](https://bonega.ai): Long-form AI video generation. Extended content with maintained quality and coherence.
- [Coira.io](https://coira.io): AI-powered crypto intelligence. Institutional-grade research on thousands of digital assets.
- [WaiverKit](https://waiverkit.io): Digital liability waiver software. Gyms, climbing parks, and rentals replace paper with a QR flow, signed on phone, stored with a legal timestamp.
